title: Monomorphy of a descended section with exact stabilizer
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings, g in R, iota:R -> H, and C a finite faithfully flat domain H-algebra with algebraMap H C (iota(g)) nonzero. Let a finite group G act by H-algebra homomorphisms rho satisfying the identity and multiplication laws. Assume the principal open V=D(algebraMap H C (iota(g))) maps etale to Spec H, and that for every field Omega any two C -> Omega agreeing on H and avoiding this denominator differ by exactly one rho(zeta). Let p:Y -> Spec R be any scheme morphism. Let t:T -> Spec R, k:V -> T commute with the structural map to Spec R, and let delta identify Y times_R T with d copies of T over T. For x in Fin d, let K be exactly its stabilizer under the action of [lem-sbc-affine-torsor-split-label-laws]. Let F be the intersection over zeta in K of the equalizer subalgebras of rho(zeta) and id, U=D(algebraMap H F (iota(g))) and q:V -> U the restricted Spec map of F -> C. Suppose f:U -> Y times_R Spec H has second projection equal to the canonical U -> Spec H and q followed by f and the first projection equals the selected split x-section. Then f is a monomorphism of schemes. No finiteness or etaleness hypothesis on p or on a factorization of p through D(g) is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and finite permutation sets; affine description of subgroup quotients

proof.text: Apply lem-sbc-affine-torsor-invariant-puncture-etale to H, h=iota(g), C and K. The structural map u:U -> Spec H is etale. Since f followed by the second projection is u, Mathlib FormallyUnramified.of_comp and locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp make f formally unramified and locally of finite type; FormallyUnramified.isOpenImmersion_diagonal makes its diagonal an open immersion.

C is integral over H because it is module-finite. For the subalgebra F, IsIntegral.tower_top makes C integral over F. RingHom.IsIntegral.comap_surjective, with the injective inclusion F -> C, gives lying over. Restrict this surjection to D(h): membership pulls back under comap, so q:V -> U is surjective. For each zeta in K, the equalizer membership of every element of F says rho(zeta) fixes that element. Cancel U -> Spec F to obtain deck(zeta) followed by q equals q.

On the connected nonempty puncture V, reproduce the split-section reconstruction: the image of the map into the split coproduct lies in the clopen summand containing its generic point. Lift into that summand and use the second projection to identify the lift with k. Thus deck(zeta) followed by section(x) equals section(action(zeta,x)), with precisely the explicit label of lem-sbc-affine-torsor-split-label-laws. Given field-valued a,b:Spec Omega -> V whose q,f images coincide, project to H and use hrot to obtain b=a followed by deck(zeta). Project to Y and apply reconstruction; the two coproduct labels at the same field point agree, hence action(zeta,x)=x. By hK, zeta belongs to K, and its invariance of q gives a followed by q equals b followed by q.

For z in U times_f U, form E=V times_U (U times_f U) using the first projection, then W=V times_U E using the second projection. Each map W -> E -> U times_f U is surjective by stability under base change, so lift z to W. The residue field of the lift supplies maps a,b to V with equal q,f images. The previous step makes their q-images equal. Pullback.hom_ext factors the residue-field map through the diagonal; its closed point maps to z. Thus the diagonal is surjective. Mathlib isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective and pullback.isIso_diagonal_iff yield Mono f.

proof_origin.note: Direct proof of the geometric cancellation and diagonal argument. Uses the existing invariant-puncture etaleness statement instead of constructing a subgroup quotient in this module. No new public statements or holes; private helpers are proved.

theorem affine_torsor_stabilizer_section_mono
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    [Module.Finite H C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C (ι g) ≠ 0)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hEt : Etale (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C))))
    (hrot : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : G, a.comp (ρ ζ).toRingHom = b)
    (d : ℕ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec R)
    (k : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ⟶ T)
    (hk : k ≫ t = Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
    (δ : pullback p t ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ T)
    (hδ : δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 T) = pullback.snd p t)
    (x : Fin d) (K : Subgroup G)
    (hK : ∀ ζ, ζ ∈ K ↔
      fixedPunctureDescentAction R H g ι C G ρ hρone hρmul hne
        p T t k hk d δ hδ ζ x = x) :
    let F := (⨅ ζ : K, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
    let U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of F)).Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H F (ι g))
    let q := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom F.val.toRingHom)).resLE
      U (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) (by
        change PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≤
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))
        rfl)
    ∀ (f : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F)) U ⟶
        pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))),
      f ≫ pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) =
        Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F)) U ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H F)) →
      q ≫ f ≫ pullback.fst p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) =
        fixedSplitSection p t k d δ x →
      Mono f
